profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Add one part careful organizer, one part rabid customer advocate, and one part strong drive for results.  Slowly bring to a simmer with interesting problems, season to taste with Star Wars quotes or perhaps a touch of single malt.  Allow to cool only briefly, and you have one Chris Taylor.

Experience spans many technologies and roles, from as arcane as LISP-style interpreted code for live multiplayer gaming to the common React front-end development, from the hidden confines of petabytes of daily data analysis to the up-front role of building front-end to serve millions of customers, from as simple as building out unit tests to as complicated as designing a publicly-accessible back-end available to any consumer with a front-end that services millions of end-users monthly.

Let's solve some truly interesting problems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Infrastructure Architect - Redesigned Xbox Rewards backend into modern Azure infrastructure

Technical Lead - Oversee backend development for interconnected commerce and banking services to service the Xbox Mastercard program

Cybersecurity SME - Security Advisor and Engineer working with multiple teams to develop solutions within established wide-spread security initiatives

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Xbox
positions.description:
Technical Lead - support.xbox.com - Oversee and architect migration from .NET stack to React, including interaction with a wide base of web services with varying authentication and data contract needs, including rendering of content from an in-house CMS.

Architect - XAC SDK - Providing a centralized client library for a breadth of services to allow swift iteration of multiple end clients in React.  Developed release methodologies, overall architecture, and full-stack integration to support React, React Native, and  React Native for Windows (Xbox Console) clients.

Mobile Developer - Xbox Assist - Bringing Assist features to the Xbox app for mobile via React Native in hybrid native apps.

Console Application Developer (Xbox) - Xbox Assist - Building out React Native for Windows application based on consistent feature set and shared service SDK

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack .NET Web Development for a web application interacting with an internal business division, hundreds of partner companies, and millions of end users.
Agile methodology applied to a customer-obsessed, feature-driven project.
